title: Level 2 — Earth observation
subtitle: Design, launch and operate a satellite in low Earth orbit
briefing: Pick a science objective, build the satellite and choose a launcher that can carry its mass.
The orbit decides coverage: a polar orbit sees the whole planet; an equatorial one, only the tropics.
Operate for 3 days: store data, downlink it during ground station passes and watch the battery during eclipses.
objectives: Launch without exceeding the launcher's capacity or the budget.
Downlink at least 2,000 MB of useful data.

obj-oceans.name: Ocean temperature
obj-oceans.description: Works in any orbit; better with more data.

orb-equatorial.name: Equatorial, 500 km
orb-equatorial.description: Tropics only; more passes over the station.

lv-falcon9.name: Falcon 9 (rideshare)
lv-falcon9.description: Plenty of mass margin; expensive for a small satellite.
